lens: Geometry and proportion first, measured at the matched q15 against y_47300 resized to 930x575, using raterB33/m.py re-pointed at r34 (raterB34/m.py: patch stats, dark runs L<35 on rows 505/530/560). Then the studio close-ups e1 / e3 / e7 / e10_under / e11_panedge against y_47302 (raterB33/p302crop.png), and q16-q18 against y_47301 / 47303 / 47305. Then materials, colour and artefacts. Crops are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Calc/7507bc7d-234c-52a3-965a-1562a4a65706/scratchpad/raterB34: z_pans.png (q15 rows 400-575 over y_47300), z_far.png (rows 150-330), z_e11.png (pan front zoom), pair16/17/18.png. A q15 diff against w33 changes 7.5 % of pixels, all in rows 399-571, so the far rows and backs are unchanged and the c312230 lighting snapshot does not move the econ cameras. The q16 / q17 cameras are framed differently from the photos (that belongs to QA / lighting); I compared parts, not layout.

priorIssues.id: w33b-1 (medium) pan joints 9-12 px dark V head-on
priorIssues.note: q15 row 560 dark runs: render 285(2)+289(2), 461(3)+467(2), 637(6). In w33 they were 289(9), 460(4)+467(5), 634(6)+641(2); the photo has 2 px at 276 / 449 / 467. In z_pans the centre and left joints now read as hairline seams, with no proud filler. The right joint is still a 6 px dark run (see w34b-4).

priorIssues.id: w33b-2 (medium) pan front too thick and too round in plan
priorIssues.note: e11 / z_e11: a near-vertical fabric face with a tight ~3 cm roll at the top. The front now reads about 7-8 cm against ~7 cm in y_47302, the plan corners are near-square, and the corners no longer droop. Under it a dark tray shows only as a thin shadow line.

priorIssues.id: w33b-3 (medium) life-vest holder an opaque black puck with a red stick
priorIssues.note: The shape is now a flat half-disc with a red strap and blue tag (e10 / e1 / e7), much closer to y_47302. It still reads as opaque near-black, though: the inner core #2e3036 fills 0.075/0.095 of the radius, so only an 8 mm rim reads lighter. In y_47302 the pouch is smoky see-through grey with a pale rim, and the vest inside reads mid-grey and brown. Strap and tag are good (see w34b-2).

priorIssues.id: w33b-4 (low) under-pan stack of grey rails; legs plain boxes
priorIssues.note: Under the pan is now dark: tray #2c2f35, beams and tubes UND #3a3d44, and the stiffener is gone. e10 / e11 show no light lip. The legs are now slim silver tubes on a floor rail, which reads right from the aisle in q17. The perforated front channel of y_47302 is not modelled. A new item: the SEATMAT.black SEB brick (0.22 x 0.10 x 0.30 at y 0.19) dominates e10 / e7 as a flat black block (w34b-6).

priorIssues.id: w33b-5 (low) fleck dark specks with light halos
priorIssues.note: z_e11: unchanged, with ~15-20 dark 1-2 cm blotches with pale rings per pan face.

priorIssues.id: w33b-6 (low) far rows snowy tick stripes, pad ears not distinct
priorIssues.note: z_far: far backs and headrests are unchanged. Stats: far centre L131.3 B/R 1.32 vs 115.3 / 1.48; far left p90/p10 3.63 vs 5.88. The new far-LOD under-pan block and baggage bar are only visible in q16 / q17 rows 4+, where they correctly give a dark band under the pans.
Unchanged geometry; z_far shows the near covers still clearly larger relative to the pad than in y_47300.
z_pans: straight-edged rounded rectangles; y_47300 shows bow-ties with pointed corners and a centre dent.
As w33b-4. e10 / e11 are dark under the pan.

priorIssues.id: w33a-4 (low, A) aisle-end lower member 1.55x deep
priorIssues.note: q17: the aisle-end lower bar is now close to the arm's depth, as in y_47303. e3 shows it as a slim plate.

priorIssues.id: w33a-6 (low, A) belts V with buckles in the hero view

details.refs: Seat 1 pan x250-330: L68.9 B/R 1.96 vs 78.9 / 1.77, now slightly too dark and blue (#4b537a). Seat 2 x330-450: L85.5, p90/p10 3.06 vs 74.7 / 4.81. Backs unchanged.
Pan x470-600: B/R 1.78 vs 1.87 (w33 1.66), p90/p10 1.71 vs 1.95, L81.7 vs 70 (mostly lighting). #44496b pulled the ground back toward the photo.
Dark haloed specks are still on the pan face (z_e11, w33b-5).
The aisle-end lower plate is now ~8 cm and reads as the y_47303 bar in q17. Pads unchanged.
Joints 2-6 px vs 2 (w33 9-12). Front ~7-8 cm with a tight top roll and near-square corners (z_e11 vs p302crop). One joint is still 6 px.

Dark under-pan zone, slim silver legs on a rail, and a baggage bar, which matches y_47302 / 47303 in tone. Shortfalls: the pouch is still opaque black, the electronics box hangs ~3 cm below and ~9 cm behind the pan front (y_47302 has it tucked right under the bullnose), the SEB brick is a dominant flat black block, and the front leg has no perforated channel.
The new dark under-pan band and baggage bar help q16 / q17 rows 4+. The far backs and headrests (q15 z_far) are unchanged: L131 / B/R 1.32 vs 115 / 1.48, with snowy stripes and no pad ears.

issues.title: Life-vest pouch shaped right but reads opaque black, not smoky see-through
issues.evidence: e10 / e1 / e7: a near-black half-disc with an ~8 mm grey rim. y_47302 (p302crop): a smoky grey see-through pouch with a pale rim, the folded vest inside showing mid-grey and brown, and the whole thing reading lighter than the black under-seat around it.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js econSeat pouch: rim disc c '#5a5f68' -> '#7c818a', r 0.18 -> 0.12 (glossy). Shrink the core gCyl 0.075 -> 0.06 and recolour '#2e3036' -> '#4d4a47' (the vest showing through). Add a third thin half-disc (0.09, 0.002 thick, c '#8f949c', r 0.08) 4 mm in front as a glossy face, so the pouch reads lighter than the #2c2f35 tray behind it.

issues.title: Electronics box hangs below and well behind the pan front
issues.evidence: Code: gRBox(0.075, 0.085, 0.05) at y 0.30, z -0.40, so its top is 0.343, about 3 cm under the tray (0.354), and its face is at z -0.425, about 9 cm behind the pan front (~-0.515). In e10 / e11 it floats in front of the front tube. In y_47302 the grey box sits right under the bullnose, its face ~2-3 cm behind the fabric face, butted against the leg / arm side.
issues.fix: Move the box to M4.trs(x0 - 0.17, 0.315, -0.465) and the display / LED quads to z -0.4905 / -0.4907 (y 0.33 / 0.305), so the top meets the tray and the face sits ~5 cm behind the pan front. Extend the tray gRBox depth 0.36 -> 0.42 (centre z -0.235 -> -0.265) so the box hangs from it.

issues.title: One pan joint still a 6 px dark run (others 2-3 px)
issues.evidence: raterB34/m.py row 560: 637(6) vs the photo's 2 px. The other joints are 285/289 and 461/467 at 2-3 px each, separated by a lit roll.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js: widen ps[1] / ps[2] 0.466 / 0.47 -> 0.472 / 0.476 and the roll base 0.47 -> 0.476 in the k-loop. That still clears ECON_PLATE (check the arm plate x ± 0.015 against sp / 2 - 0.238). Alternatively drop ex 0.016 -> 0.012 so the side rolls stay full height longer.

issues.title: Far rows: snowy stripes and no pad ears (carried)
issues.evidence: z_far is unchanged: far centre L131 / B/R 1.32 vs 115 / 1.48, far left p90/p10 3.63 vs 5.88.
